The available findings either report different casualty numbers (e.g., 11 killed) or do not couple the fatality count with a precise weapons‑seizure figure. Consequently, the claim that one airstrike produced those exact totals remains unverified; the totals appear to belong to separate reports or operations. --- ### Reasoning | Step | Observation | Inference | Uncertainty | |------|-------------|-----------|-------------| | 1 | The Archive contains a verified claim that “Colombian troops killed 11 dissidents of the disbanded FARC guerrilla group” (source: DefenceTalk). | The most concrete casualty figure publicly recorded is 11, not 4. | The archive may be incomplete;
